ash: Quick sync — Q2 runtime prioritization. Customer asks piling up on embeddings throughput and p95. Can we do a 3pm sync? Agenda: kernels, quant, KV cache, launch gates.
maria: 3pm works for me. Can we loop in eng-sre for canary/runbook? @kevin @raj
kevin: yep. Major ask from enterprise trial: p95 <= 120ms at ~2k rps for embeddings baseline. That feels ambitious but worth sizing.
olivia: we should propose a graded rollout: opt quant on canary with automatic fallback to fp16 kernels. Launch criteria idea: smoke + perf/regression eval pass, perf delta <5% for quality vs current.
raj: customer dataset has long-tail prompts. KV cache hit-rate matters — could save ~40% token work. Plan: measure prefix distribution and target ~70% hit for common prefixes as a short-term goal.

ash: back on track — propose priority order: 1) KV short-term (config + metrics), 2) kernel selection (cuda paths + new kernels), 3) quant canary + rollback policy. Thoughts?
maria: agree. Also add auto-batching tuning between 1 and 2 — that gives big throughput wins for many workloads.
kevin: quick question re canary: ops wants an abort threshold if quant causes >2% quality regression or latency spike. Need automatic fallback policy defined.
olivia: totally. Add these rollout metrics: p50/p95 latency, top-k accuracy on eval set, token-cost delta, KV hit-rate. Also include a 'staging traffic split' config for progressive ramp.
ash: (accidental post)
ash_delete: (ignore)
ash: I'll draft a short launch checklist. Rough thresholds to discuss: beta p95 <= 140ms, GA p95 <= 120ms; quality drop thresholds — we should decide beta vs GA.
raj: GA should be stricter. Proposal: beta p95 <=140ms, GA <=120ms; quality drop <=2% for beta, <=1% for GA. That gives room to iterate after beta.
kevin: :thumbsup: I'll prep the KV instrumentation PR — estimate ~3 days.
deploy-bot: Canary job started: runtime/kernels-canary-1995012400. Link: https://internal/build/12345 :rocket:
maria: I can own the rollout config + runbooks. @ash please add action items to roadmap doc and link the runbook.

ash: thanks all — moving action items to the roadmap doc and OKR epic. Meeting 3pm. cc: @sre-team
